# Surya Jewellers
> Surya Jewellers is a family-owned 92.5 sterling silver jewellery manufacturer based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Founded in 2003 by Sanjay Chandra and Pooja Chandra, we craft handcrafted rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, pendants, and studs set with certified natural gemstones including diamonds, rubies, emeralds, sapphires, opals, moonstones, tanzanite, and more. Approximately 90% of our designs are one-piece, one-design creations — unique pieces you will not find elsewhere. Every Surya Jewellers piece comes with a Certificate of Authenticity verifying the 92.5 sterling silver purity, gemstone type, and carat weight.

## Brand Identity
- Brand: Surya Jewellers
- Type: Jewellery Manufacturer & Retailer
- Speciality: 92.5 Sterling Silver (hallmarked 925) with natural certified gemstones
- Founded: 2003
- Founders: Sanjay Chandra and Pooja Chandra
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (the gemstone capital of the world)
- Unique Selling Point: 90% one-piece, one-design creations; Certificate of Authenticity on every piece; lifetime maintenance
